name: online-python-turtle-editor
description: A browser-based Python turtle editor for intro programming classes. Real CPython, real error messages, no AI assistance, nothing sent anywhere.

scripts.test: npm run test:fast && npm run test:security && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:fast: node test/csp.test.mjs && node test/sanitize.test.mjs && node test/share.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node test/renderer.browser.mjs && node test/phase0.browser.mjs && node test/phase1.browser.mjs && node test/phase2.browser.mjs && node test/phase3.browser.mjs && node test/phase4.browser.mjs
